name: João Neiva (Brazil)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red in the colours of Italy, the white charged with a red-outlined triangle bearing a green hill, a locomotive and the dates 1988 and 1906.
history: João Neiva is a municipality in the state of Espírito Santo, Brazil, settled by Italian immigrants. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag, created by Rodrigo Frigini de Marchi, was chosen in a municipal contest: the Italian colours recall the immigrants, the locomotive the town's origin, Monte Negro the landmark hill, 1906 the settlement and 1988 the emancipation of the municipality.

features.role: triangle outlined in red with a hill, a locomotive and the dates 1906 and 1988
